searched_no_result.document: Bhutan National Bank, Annual Report 2024 (bnb.bt), full text extracted and searched
searched_no_result.sections_read: 'Board of DIRECTORS' page (p.9), 'EXECUTIVE' page (p.11), 'Senior MANAGEMENT' page, and every occurrence of 'shareholder', 'ownership', 'Royal Monetary Authority', 'National Pension', 'Druk Holding'
searched_no_result.finding: The board page lists seven directors by name and title only, with no biographies and no employment history. There is no shareholding-pattern table anywhere in the report; the only holder identified is by the parenthesis '(DHI)' after director Sonam Tobgay, DHI being the state holding company Druk Holding and Investments. Bhutan is now closed at both commercial banks: Bank of Bhutan (round 1) and Bhutan National Bank (this round).

searched_no_result.document: Banca Agricola Commerciale, Bilancio Consolidato 2024 (bac.sm), full text extracted and searched
searched_no_result.sections_read: The 'Consiglio di Amministrazione' / 'Direttore Generale' front pages and every occurrence of 'azionist', 'soci', 'capitale sociale', 'Presidente'
searched_no_result.finding: The front pages name the officers and the dates the Assemblea dei soci appointed them - President Emanuele Cesarini (appointed by the Assemblea dei soci), a Vice President, a Direttore Generale and further appointments dated 27/02/2025 and 28/05/2024 - but carry no biographies and no career history, and there is no shareholder table. searched_no_result.document: National Bank of Iraq (al-Masraf al-Ahli al-Iraqi), Annual Report 2023 (nbi.iq), Arabic text normalised and searched end to end
searched_no_result.sections_read: Section 3 'majlis idarat al-masraf' (board, all seven members with qualifications and 'al-khibrat' experience blocks), section 5 'a'da al-idara al-tanfidhiyya' (executive management, with dated employer-by-employer career lists), and every occurrence of 'al-bank al-markazi' in the document
searched_no_result.finding: This is a document of exactly the right shape - dated career lists plus a stated ownership figure - and it still produces nothing for Iraq. Ownership is stated: 'Capital Bank, which owns about 62% of the bank's capital, is the gateway for the National Bank of Iraq to open onto the world's economies'. But not one of the board or executive career lists includes the Central Bank of Iraq. The employers that do appear are Bank of Baghdad, Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, Dar Es Salaam Bank, Bank Audi Baghdad and Bank Audi Lebanon, PricewaterhouseCoopers Jordan, Citibank, Standard Chartered, the Jordanian Social Security Corporation, the Jordanian Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Labour. The single central bank in the whole document is a foreign one, in the managing director's bio (see leads_not_opened).

searched_no_result.document: Islamic First Iraqi Bank (First Iraq Islamic Bank), Annual Report 2024 in English (fib.iq), full text searched

No career list, so no record.

searched_no_result.document: Banco Caboverdiano de Negocios (BCN), Relatorio e Contas 2024 (bcn.cv), full text extracted and searched
searched_no_result.sections_read: The bank history pages, 'Estrutura Acionista' (p.12), 'Orgaos Sociais a data de 31 de dezembro de 2024' (p.11), and every occurrence of 'Banco de Cabo Verde', 'acionista', 'exerceu funcoes', 'carreira'

leads_not_opened.note: NOT one of this round's targets, but a career move keyed to Saudi Arabia found in passing and worth passing to whoever holds SAU. The National Bank of Iraq's 2023 annual report, in the bio of managing director and board member Ayman Omran Abdullah Abu Dheim, states that he 'held the post of head of the financial and banking studies unit at the Banking Institute affiliated to the Saudi Central Bank', before joining Capital Bank Group / Jordan as head of financial management in 2011 and then the National Bank of Iraq. The same document states the hiring side's ownership: 'Capital Bank, which owns about 62% of the bank's capital'. Page 166 of the Arabic PDF.

Iraqi Securities Commission disclosure filings carry the same board-and-executive CV format as the National Bank of Iraq report (dated employer-by-employer lists under the heading 'al-khibrat'), so one of them is the likeliest place a Central Bank of Iraq veteran's name sits.
